description: Windows data recovery utility for recovering deleted files and data from damaged file systems.

script: if (!(Test-Path -LiteralPath $msi -PathType Leaf)) { throw ('O&O DiskRecovery MSI was not found: ' + $msi) }
if ($process.ExitCode -notin @(0, 3010)) { throw "O&O DiskRecovery installation failed with exit code $($process.ExitCode). Log: $log" }
if (!(Test-Path -LiteralPath $msi -PathType Leaf)) { throw ('O&O DiskRecovery MSI was not found: ' + $msi) }
if ($null -eq $record) { throw 'Could not read ProductCode from the retained MSI.' }
if ($process.ExitCode -notin @(0, 3010, 1605)) { throw "O&O DiskRecovery uninstallation failed with exit code $($process.ExitCode). Log: $log" }

notes: Nonportable: uses O&O's official per-machine Windows Installer package and registers the application with Windows. Scoop uninstall removes the MSI ProductCode. Administrator approval is required; a restart may be requested. Scoop retains the original MSI in its version directory so its ProductCode remains available for native Windows Installer removal.
